# Python dev toolchain for `make test` and the quality gates (built into .local/venv-dev by `make venv`, which
# installs with pip --require-hashes). Direct requirements, each justified in docs/dependencies.md:
#   plugin runtime (the versions of the Hermes venv the plugin runs in): aiohttp, jsonschema, PyYAML, cryptography;
#   test and quality tools (dev-only): pytest, ruff, mypy, types-PyYAML, import-linter, coverage, pytest-cov,
#   hypothesis.
# Every transitive dependency is pinned too (the full `pip freeze` of the venv, Python 3.14), each with the SHA-256
# of every file PyPI publishes for that version (all wheels + sdist), so any platform installs exactly these bytes
# or fails. Regenerate after changing a pin: pip freeze of the rebuilt venv, then the digests from
# https://pypi.org/pypi/<name>/<version>/json (equivalent to pip-compile --generate-hashes); recipe in
# docs/troubleshooting/pip-require-hashes-missing-hash.md. Upgrading a pin is its own change with its own task id.
